name: @dojo-tools/next-block-estimator
description: A script estimating the minimum feerate required for the inclusion of a bitcoin transaction into the next block.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:clean && pnpm run build:esm && pnpm run build:types
scripts.prepack: pnpm install && pnpm -w run lint && pnpm run typescript && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
scripts.lint: pnpm exec biome lint src test
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm exec biome lint --write src test
scripts.format: pnpm exec biome format --write src test

author: Katana Cryptographic Ltd.
